CustomField.description: Global kill switch. When checked, DLE_EmailDispatchService.sendEmail returns immediately without resolving config, sending any email, or writing DLE_Email_Log__c rows. A scheduled send that fires while this is checked is recorded with accepted 0 (Failed). Left unchecked (the default, including when no setting record exists) the engine sends normally.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Check to stop the engine sending any Donor Lifecycle email. Emergency use only.
CustomField.label: Disable All Sends
